pages.text: A torch burning $(l:threats/hollow)Hollow$(/l) Frozen Breath.$(li)Light level 15, snowflake particles$(li)$(bold)Hollows within 16 blocks flee$(), fast$(li)Returned Hunters cannot break it$(br2)Normal torches only keep Hollows off at close range. Ring your base with these.
$(italic)Why a ghost's own breath repels it is unknown. Working theory: spite.$()
Frozen Breath over a Stick. Yields 4. Getting the Frozen Breath is the hard part, on account of the ghost.
